name: Osmin
tagline: GPS navigation for roads and trails, powered by OpenStreetMap
description:
Osmin is a GPS navigator for Android that works both on paved roads and off-road trails. It's built on OpenStreetMap data, giving you turn-by-turn style guidance whether you're driving through town or hiking a backcountry path.

It's a lightweight, open-source option for anyone who wants map navigation without relying on Google Maps.
